note: make_cluster.py benches: the kind of every FO4 crafting station (FURN with a WBDT bench type) by FO4 base editor id (exact, or 'prefix*'); the kind picks the vanilla Starfield bench the reference binds to (make_cluster.BENCH_KINDS: weapon 2B6A63 WorkbenchWeapon, armor 2B6A62 WorkbenchArmor, chem 2B6A61 WorkbenchChem, cooking 2B6A65 WorkbenchFood; docs/terrain/stations.md). A kind of null leaves the station a static, with the reason. No default: a bench type without an entry is listed as skipped (unknown kind), never guessed.

WorkbenchPowerArmor*.reason: power armor station: Starfield has no bench type 8 (2B6A64 WorkbenchRobotStation is DONOTUSE); stays a static
